valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 Adjusted Diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Macro softening slows system-wide RevPAR growth to ~2% and compresses the multiple

base.driver: Steady ~4% RevPAR growth, 6-7% net unit growth from the 543,100-room pipeline, and ongoing buybacks

bull.driver: Stronger business/group travel and faster pipeline conversions lift fee-based earnings

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $10.55, the $373.09 close implies 35.4x forward P/E; the ~$374.19 Street consensus target implies 35.5x at base EPS or $11.01 EPS at 34.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $10.55 (2.8 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: System-wide comparable RevPAR growth (currency-neutral) and net unit growth / pipeline openings

analyst_notes: Following Hilton's Q3 2026 beat ($2.45 adjusted EPS, +5.8% RevPAR) and raised FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance ($9.07-$9.13), several named analysts raised targets, including Mizuho's Ben Chaiken ($329 to $421, upgraded to Outperform) and Bernstein's Richard Clarke ($320 to $380, Market Perform). Street consensus (~$374.19) sits roughly 4.3 pp above the $358.70 base case, reflecting a ~35.5x multiple on base FY2027E EPS versus our 34.0x assumption. Target horizons are marked null where the 12-month horizon was not explicitly documented in the secondary source.
